class Solution:
    def canCompleteCircuit(self, gas: List[int], cost: List[int]) -> int:
        total_gas = 0
        total_cost = 0
        tank = 0
        start = 0
        for i in range(len(gas)):
            total_gas += gas[i]
            total_cost += cost[i]
            tank += gas[i] - cost[i]
            if tank < 0:
                start = i + 1
                tank = 0
        return -1 if total_gas < total_cost else start
